ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent charges announced against a Medicaid provider in Minnesota and explore the broader issue of Medicaid fraud in the state.
questions: What are the extent and scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are current oversight and accountability measures in preventing Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program.

ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Investigations on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would explore the impact of federal investigations on local communities, including the recent investigation into Foxboro Public Schools.
questions: What are the potential consequences of federal investigations on local communities?
How can local communities prepare for and respond to federal investigations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the importance of transparency and accountability in federal investigations and their impact on local communities.
